tests: How to cost-effectively offload repetitive read queries from a primary RDS MySQL without changing writes.
expected: Add RDS read replicas and route reads to them. Triggers: "read-heavy", "scale reads without changing the write path", "cost-effective".
why_not: Scaling up is more expensive and limited; Multi-AZ — availability, the standby does not serve reads; migrating to DynamoDB — major rework.
